title: Change board, Beinasco
utterances: Deviation request DEV-127: Meccanica Chisone as temporary source for BR-220, six weeks.
Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.
Rejected. No temporary source for BR-220 without 6082-T6 capability and a closed 8D.
Then we expedite Bormida and I tell Aurelia the plan.

decisions.text: Reject DEV-127. Expedite SUP-B for BR-220.
decisions.reason: SUP-C has no EN AW-6082-T6 capability and 8D-25-031 is open.
decisions.quote: Rejected. No temporary source for BR-220 without 6082-T6 capability and a closed 8D.
